# Open Klippah

> Open Klippah is an open-source AI video clipper that turns long videos into captioned, vertical short-form clips for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and similar platforms.

Open Klippah can be used as a hosted web application, as a native iOS app, or self-hosted from its AGPL-3.0 source code. The workflow accepts YouTube URLs and uploaded video files, transcribes the source, proposes promising segments, scores candidate clips, creates face-aware vertical crops, adds word-synced captions, and exports platform-ready videos.

## Canonical website

- [Open Klippah](https://www.openklippah.com/): Product overview, features, pricing, and hosted application access.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/aiwithenoch/OPEN-KLIPPAH): Source code, setup instructions, architecture, license, and contribution history.
- [Open Klippah for iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/openklippah/id6784760040): Native iPhone app on the App Store, backed by the hosted service.

- [AI video clipper](https://www.openklippah.com/ai-video-clipper): AI-assisted highlight detection, virality scoring, captions, and exports.
- [Open-source video clipper](https://www.openklippah.com/open-source-video-clipper): Self-hosting, source access, provider choice, and deployment tradeoffs.
- [YouTube Shorts clipper](https://www.openklippah.com/youtube-shorts-clipper): Workflow for repurposing long YouTube videos into vertical Shorts.
- [Demo](https://www.openklippah.com/demo): Real clips generated from a long-form interview, with source timestamps and pipeline steps.

## Key capabilities

- AI-assisted clip discovery and candidate scoring.
- YouTube URL and uploaded-file inputs.
- Face-aware 9:16 vertical reframing.
- Word-synced animated captions and caption templates.
- Export presets for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels.
- Hosted web usage, an iOS app, or AGPL-3.0 self-hosting.
- Support for configured hosted language-model providers or Ollama.
- Transcription via AssemblyAI (default), local Whisper, or YouTube captions.
- REST API with per-user API keys, and an MCP server for AI clients.
- No watermark on exported clips.

## Important qualifications

- Virality scores prioritize candidates; they do not guarantee audience performance.
- The source code is free, but self-hosters provide their own infrastructure and any paid transcription or model-provider usage.
- The hosted service requires a paid plan (Pro or Scale) to process videos; self-hosted installs have no plan limits.
- Users should process only videos they own or have permission to repurpose.
- Product capabilities and pricing can change; use the canonical website and repository for current details.
